summary: This episode note from The Office describes the birth aftermath of Pam and Jim's baby Cecelia. Pam struggles to breastfeed despite help from a male lactation consultant, and the couple keep Cecelia in their room overnight against the nurse's advice. A sleep-deprived Pam accidentally nurses another new mom's baby, and as the couple leave the hospital, Pam feeds Cecelia while Jim fetches the car, which is covered in parking tickets from Michael.
one_line: Summary of The Office episode "The Delivery", covering Pam's difficult breastfeeding, a mix-up with another mother's baby, and the family's hospital departure.
key_facts: Pam's breastfeeding does not go well with her baby Cecelia.
A male lactation consultant, Lee Kirk, is summoned to coach Pam and apparently succeeds.
Lee Kirk is Jenna Fischer's husband and was her fiance at that time.
Cecelia still fails to "latch" properly after the lactation coaching.
Against the advice of the nurse, Jim and Pam choose to have Cecelia spend the night with them instead of in the nursery.
Jim and Pam are kept up for long hours tending to Cecelia.
A sleep-deprived Pam accidentally nurses a baby that belongs to a new mom played by Melissa Rauch, in the same hospital room.
As Jim and Pam get ready to leave the hospital, Pam breastfeeds Cecelia while Jim gets the car.
The car is littered with parking tickets because Michael parked it in an ambulance-only zone.
